notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
-> New map.
-> Bug fixes.
-> New zombies.
-> Small changes.

notes.title: Update 1.1 set to release around february/march
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256966/f970660841df51de77be0b45202a7bb4d3a2bf1c.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] When kicking while shooting the weapon got stuck in the character's hand.
[*] Zombies couldn't climb walls that were above the player.
[*] Zombies would play the climb animation while walking up stair/slopes.
[*] Zombies were spawning inside walls.
[*] Zombies couldn't rotate to face the character correctily.
[*] Pistol would get stuck in the reload animation and not be able to shoot anymore.
[*] AR could shoot one extra bullet if clicking fast enough (resulting on negative numbers).
[*] Some of the character animations were not playing as they should.
[/list]
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New map, once you get in to the elevator you're transported to the next level inside the facility.
[*] New enemy, security robot that will shoot the player on site, best to avoid direct contact.
[*] New visuals for: ammo box, first aid kit, zombies, player character (second level), wires that connect to interactables, etc.
[/list]
